ns2:section.sectionText: Description: This course critically examines the ways in which information technologies are both the source and consequence of race and gender relations. Will explore theories of race, gender and technology and apply these to case studies of information and communication technologies (ICTs). Particular attention will be given to globalization, privacy and surveillance, labor, and "digital enclosures". Meets w/LIS 390 (CRN 61741, Sec. RGI
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
